description: This PHP source file defines the Vtiger_SalesOrderPDFController class, which extends InventoryPDFController to generate PDF representations of sales orders in the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for building header models, retrieving header viewers, and formatting various parts of the sales order PDF.

classes.name: Vtiger_SalesOrderPDFController
classes.description: Controller class for generating Sales Order PDFs, extending InventoryPDFController with specific header and content formatting methods.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelTitle
methods.description: Builds the title for the PDF header, including sales order number.

methods.name: getHeaderViewer
methods.description: Returns the header viewer object for the PDF.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelColumnLeft
methods.description: Builds the left column of the header with quote name.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelColumnCenter
methods.description: Builds the center column with subject, customer, contact, and purchase order details.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelColumnRight
methods.description: Builds the right column with issue date, due date, billing, and shipping addresses.

methods.name: getWatermarkContent
methods.description: Returns the watermark content based on sales order status.
